sloka: धूम्राक्षं ताडितं दृष्ट्वा पतितं शोणितोक्षितम् ।अभ्यधावत सङ्ग्रामे माणिभद्रं दशाननः ।। ७.१५.१२ ॥
transliteration: dhūmrākṣaṁ tāḍitaṁ dṛṣṭvā patitaṁ śoṇitokṣitam ।abhyadhāvata saṅgrāme māṇibhadraṁ daśānanaḥ ।। 7.15.12 ॥

translations.english: Having seen Dhūmrākṣa struck, fallen, and drenched in blood, Daśānana rushed towards Maṇibhadra in battle.
